verses.original: μου Ἀδελφοί ἔχετε τὴν πίστιν τοῦ ἡμῶν τῆς δόξης Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ μὴ ἐν προσωπολημψίαις
verses.transliteration: mou Adelphoi echete tēn pistin tou hēmōn tēs doxēs Kyriou Iēsou Christou mē en prosōpolēmpsiais
verses.literal: My brothers as you hold out [your] faith in our vvv glorious Lord Jesus Christ {do} not [show] favoritism

verses.original: γὰρ Ἐὰν ἀνὴρ εἰσέλθῃ εἰς ὑμῶν συναγωγὴν χρυσοδακτύλιος ἐν λαμπρᾷ ἐσθῆτι δὲ πτωχὸς ἐν ῥυπαρᾷ ἐσθῆτι καὶ εἰσέλθῃ
verses.transliteration: gar Ean anēr eiselthē eis hymōn synagōgēn chrysodaktylios en lampra esthēti de ptōchos en rhypara esthēti kai eiselthē
verses.literal: vvv Suppose a man comes into your meeting [wearing] a gold ring [and] fine clothes and a poor [man] in shabby clothes also comes in

verses.original: δὲ ἐπιβλέψητε ἐπὶ τὸν φοροῦντα τὴν τὴν λαμπρὰν ἐσθῆτα καὶ εἴπητε Σὺ ὧδε κάθου καλῶς καὶ εἴπητε τῷ πτωχῷ Σὺ στῆθι ἢ Κάθου ἐκεῖ ὑπὸ μου τὸ ὑποπόδιόν
verses.transliteration: de epiblepsēte epi ton phorounta tēn tēn lampran esthēta kai eipēte Sy hōde kathou kalōs kai eipēte tō ptōchō Sy stēthi ē Kathou ekei hypo mou to hypopodion
verses.literal: [If] you lavish attention on the [man] in - - fine clothes and say - Here [is] a seat of honor [but] say to the poor [man] You must stand or Sit vvv at my - feet

verses.original: καὶ οὐ διεκρίθητε ἐν ἑαυτοῖς καὶ ἐγένεσθε κριταὶ πονηρῶν διαλογισμῶν
verses.transliteration: kai ou diekrithēte en heautois kai egenesthe kritai ponērōn dialogismōn
verses.literal: - vvv have you not discriminated among yourselves and become judges [with] evil thoughts

verses.original: Ἀκούσατε μου ἀγαπητοί ἀδελφοί οὐχ ὁ Θεὸς ἐξελέξατο τοὺς πτωχοὺς τῷ κόσμῳ πλουσίους ἐν πίστει καὶ κληρονόμους τῆς βασιλείας ἧς ἐπηγγείλατο τοῖς ἀγαπῶσιν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Akousate mou agapētoi adelphoi ouch ho Theos exelexato tous ptōchous tō kosmō plousious en pistei kai klēronomous tēs basileias hēs epēngeilato tois agapōsin auton
verses.literal: Listen my beloved brothers {Has} not - God chosen the poor - of this world [to be] rich in faith and to inherit the kingdom - He promised those who love Him

verses.original: δὲ ὑμεῖς ἠτιμάσατε τὸν πτωχόν οὐχ οἱ πλούσιοι καταδυναστεύουσιν ὑμῶν καὶ αὐτοὶ ἕλκουσιν ὑμᾶς εἰς κριτήρια
verses.transliteration: de hymeis ētimasate ton ptōchon ouch hoi plousioi katadynasteuousin hymōn kai autoi helkousin hymas eis kritēria
verses.literal: But you have dishonored the poor [Is it] not the rich who oppress you and - drag you into court

verses.original: αὐτοὶ οὐκ βλασφημοῦσιν τὸ καλὸν ὄνομα ἐφ’ ὑμᾶς τὸ ἐπικληθὲν
verses.transliteration: autoi ouk blasphēmousin to kalon onoma eph’ hymas to epiklēthen
verses.literal: {Are} they not the ones who blaspheme the noble name by which you - have been called

verses.original: Εἰ μέντοι τελεῖτε βασιλικὸν νόμον κατὰ τὴν γραφήν Ἀγαπήσεις σου τὸν πλησίον ὡς σεαυτόν ποιεῖτε καλῶς
verses.transliteration: Ei mentoi teleite basilikon nomon kata tēn graphēn Agapēseis sou ton plēsion hōs seauton poieite kalōs
verses.literal: If vvv you really fulfill [the] royal law stated in - Scripture Love your - neighbor as yourself you are doing well

verses.original: δὲ εἰ προσωπολημπτεῖτε ἐργάζεσθε ἁμαρτίαν ἐλεγχόμενοι ὑπὸ τοῦ νόμου ὡς παραβάται
verses.transliteration: de ei prosōpolēmpteite ergazesthe hamartian elenchomenoi hypo tou nomou hōs parabatai
verses.literal: But if you show favoritism you sin [and] are convicted by the law as transgressors

verses.original: γὰρ Ὅστις τηρήσῃ τὸν ὅλον νόμον δὲ πταίσῃ ἐν ἑνί γέγονεν ἔνοχος πάντων
verses.transliteration: gar Hostis tērēsē ton holon nomon de ptaisē en heni gegonen enochos pantōn
verses.literal: - Whoever keeps the whole law but stumbles at just one [point] is guilty of [breaking] all of it

verses.original: γὰρ ὁ εἰπών Μὴ μοιχεύσῃς καί εἶπεν Μὴ φονεύσῃς δὲ εἰ οὐ μοιχεύεις δέ φονεύεις γέγονας παραβάτης νόμου
verses.transliteration: gar ho eipōn Mē moicheusēs kai eipen Mē phoneusēs de ei ou moicheueis de phoneueis gegonas parabatēs nomou
verses.literal: For He who said vvv Do not commit adultery also said vvv Do not murder - If vvv you do not commit adultery but do commit murder you have become vvv a lawbreaker

verses.original: Οὕτως λαλεῖτε καὶ οὕτως ποιεῖτε ὡς μέλλοντες κρίνεσθαι διὰ νόμου ἐλευθερίας
verses.transliteration: Houtōs laleite kai houtōs poieite hōs mellontes krinesthai dia nomou eleutherias
verses.literal: - Speak and - act as those who are going to be judged by [the] law that gives freedom

verses.original: γὰρ ἡ κρίσις ἀνέλεος τῷ μὴ ποιήσαντι ἔλεος ἔλεος κατακαυχᾶται κρίσεως
verses.transliteration: gar hē krisis aneleos tō mē poiēsanti eleos eleos katakauchatai kriseōs
verses.literal: For - judgment without mercy [ will be shown to ] anyone who vvv has not been merciful . . . Mercy triumphs over judgment

verses.original: Τί τὸ ὄφελος μου ἀδελφοί ἐὰν τις λέγῃ ἔχειν πίστιν δὲ ἔχῃ μὴ ἔργα μὴ δύναται ἡ πίστις σῶσαι αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Ti to ophelos mou adelphoi ean tis legē echein pistin de echē mē erga mē dynatai hē pistis sōsai auton
verses.literal: What - good [is it] my brothers if someone claims to have faith but has no deeds vvv Can such faith save him

verses.original: ἐὰν ἀδελφὸς ἢ ἀδελφὴ ὑπάρχωσιν γυμνοὶ καὶ λειπόμενοι τῆς ἐφημέρου τροφῆς
verses.transliteration: ean adelphos ē adelphē hyparchōsin gymnoi kai leipomenoi tēs ephēmerou trophēs
verses.literal: Suppose a brother or sister is without clothes and - - daily food

verses.original: δέ τις ἐξ ὑμῶν εἴπῃ αὐτοῖς Ὑπάγετε ἐν εἰρήνῃ θερμαίνεσθε καὶ χορτάζεσθε δὲ μὴ δῶτε αὐτοῖς τὰ τοῦ σώματος ἐπιτήδεια τί τὸ ὄφελος
verses.transliteration: de tis ex hymōn eipē autois Hypagete en eirēnē thermainesthe kai chortazesthe de mē dōte autois ta tou sōmatos epitēdeia ti to ophelos
verses.literal: [If] one of you tells him Go in peace stay warm and well fed but {does} not provide for . . . [his] - physical needs what - good [ is that ]

verses.original: οὕτως καὶ ἡ πίστις καθ’ ἑαυτήν ἐὰν ἔχῃ μὴ ἔργα ἐστιν νεκρά
verses.transliteration: houtōs kai hē pistis kath’ heautēn ean echē mē erga estin nekra
verses.literal: So too - faith by itself if it does not result . . . in action is dead

verses.original: Ἀλλ’ τις ἐρεῖ Σὺ ἔχεις πίστιν κἀγὼ ἔχω ἔργα δεῖξόν μοι σου τὴν πίστιν χωρὶς τῶν ἔργων κἀγώ δείξω σοι τὴν πίστιν ἐκ μου τῶν ἔργων
verses.transliteration: All’ tis erei Sy echeis pistin kagō echō erga deixon moi sou tēn pistin chōris tōn ergōn kagō deixō soi tēn pistin ek mou tōn ergōn
verses.literal: But someone will say You have faith and I have deeds Show me your - faith without - deeds and I will show you [my] faith by my - deeds

verses.original: σὺ πιστεύεις ὅτι Θεός ἐστιν ὁ εἷς καλῶς ποιεῖς καὶ τὰ δαιμόνια πιστεύουσιν καὶ φρίσσουσιν
verses.transliteration: sy pisteueis hoti Theos estin ho heis kalōs poieis kai ta daimonia pisteuousin kai phrissousin
verses.literal: You believe that God is - one Good for you Even the demons believe [that] and shudder

verses.original: ὦ κενέ ἄνθρωπε δὲ Θέλεις γνῶναι ὅτι ἡ πίστις χωρὶς τῶν ἔργων ἐστιν ἀργή
verses.transliteration: ō kene anthrōpe de Theleis gnōnai hoti hē pistis chōris tōn ergōn estin argē
verses.literal: O foolish man - do you want evidence that - faith without - deeds is worthless

verses.original: οὐκ ἡμῶν ὁ πατὴρ Ἀβραὰμ ἐδικαιώθη ἐξ ἔργων ἀνενέγκας αὐτοῦ τὸν υἱὸν Ἰσαὰκ ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον
verses.transliteration: ouk hēmōn ho patēr Abraam edikaiōthē ex ergōn anenenkas autou ton huion Isaak epi to thysiastērion
verses.literal: {Was} not our - father Abraham justified by what he did when he offered his - son Isaac on the altar

verses.original: βλέπεις ὅτι ἡ πίστις συνήργει αὐτοῦ τοῖς ἔργοις καὶ ἡ πίστις ἐτελειώθη ἐκ τῶν ἔργων
verses.transliteration: blepeis hoti hē pistis synērgei autou tois ergois kai hē pistis eteleiōthē ek tōn ergōn
verses.literal: You see that [his] faith was working with his - actions and [his] faith was perfected by what he did

verses.original: καὶ ἡ γραφὴ ἐπληρώθη ἡ λέγουσα δὲ Ἀβραὰμ Ἐπίστευσεν τῷ Θεῷ καὶ ἐλογίσθη αὐτῷ εἰς δικαιοσύνην καὶ ἐκλήθη φίλος Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai hē graphē eplērōthē hē legousa de Abraam Episteusen tō Theō kai elogisthē autō eis dikaiosynēn kai eklēthē philos Theou
verses.literal: And the Scripture was fulfilled that says - Abraham believed - God and it was credited to him as righteousness and he was called a friend of God

verses.original: ὁρᾶτε ὅτι ἄνθρωπος δικαιοῦται ἐξ ἔργων καὶ οὐκ ἐκ πίστεως μόνον
verses.transliteration: horate hoti anthrōpos dikaioutai ex ergōn kai ouk ek pisteōs monon
verses.literal: As you can see - a man is justified by [his] deeds and not by faith alone

verses.original: δὲ Ὁμοίως οὐκ καὶ Ῥαὰβ ἡ πόρνη ἐδικαιώθη ἐξ ἔργων ὑποδεξαμένη τοὺς ἀγγέλους καὶ ἐκβαλοῦσα ἑτέρᾳ ὁδῷ
verses.transliteration: de Homoiōs ouk kai Rhaab hē pornē edikaiōthē ex ergōn hypodexamenē tous angelous kai ekbalousa hetera hodō
verses.literal: vvv In the same way {was} not even Rahab the prostitute justified by her actions when she welcomed the spies and sent [them] off on another route

verses.original: γὰρ ὥσπερ τὸ σῶμα χωρὶς πνεύματος ἐστιν νεκρόν οὕτως καὶ ἡ πίστις χωρὶς ἔργων ἐστιν νεκρά
verses.transliteration: gar hōsper to sōma chōris pneumatos estin nekron houtōs kai hē pistis chōris ergōn estin nekra
verses.literal: - As the body without [the] spirit is dead so - - faith without deeds is dead
